Navigation

Rumo magnético

The direction of flight over the ground with respect to magnetic north, obtained by correcting true course for magnetic variation.

Quick answer: The direction of flight over the ground with respect to magnetic north, obtained by correcting true course for magnetic variation.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Rumo magnético?

In this glossary, Rumo magnético refers to: The direction of flight over the ground with respect to magnetic north, obtained by correcting true course for magnetic variation.

How is Rumo magnético used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Confirme o rumo magnético para o trecho atual conforme exigido pelo ATC para atribuições de rumo."

Why does Rumo magnético matter in aviation?

Rumo magnético matters because it supports clear communication in Navigation contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.
